caveat: REAL Craft CMS is booted per version via composer (craftcms/cms pinned 5.8.20/5.8.22/5.8.23) + real MariaDB + `php craft install`. The attacker drives Craft's OWN GraphQL `save_<Volume>_Asset` mutation (_file.url) over EXTERNAL HTTP; Craft's own validateHostname()/handleUpload() (and on V2 the ON_STATS validateIp) run inside the app. NO source-lift. A real UDP DNS rebinder sidecar + metadata canary(192.0.0.192)/decoy(192.0.0.50) on 192.0.0.0/24 make the check-vs-fetch TOCTOU deterministic. Craft is composer-installed at build time; no craft tree is committed to the case dir.

audit.evidence: Real Docker: 3 Craft images (php:8.3-cli + composer craftcms/cms 5.8.20/5.8.22/5.8.23, pdo_mysql/curl/gd/intl/zip/bcmath/mbstring) + MariaDB 11 per version + UDP DNS rebinder + canary/decoy on 192.0.0.0/24. Versions confirmed via Composer\InstalledVersions (v0=5.8.20 v1=5.8.22 v2=5.8.23). External HTTP trigger: POST /index.php?p=actions/graphql/api with Craft's real save_pcbvol_Asset(_file:{url}) mutation; the SSRF'd body is stored as an asset and read back over HTTP. Gate passed on real Docker: original seed http://seed.pcb.test/flag -> FLAG@v0, blocked@v1 ('contains an invalid hostname'); residual DNS-rebind http://rebind.pcb.test/flag (CHECK->decoy 192.0.0.50, FETCH->canary 192.0.0.192, parity confirmed in dns sidecar log) -> FLAG@v1, blocked@v2 ('resolves to an invalid IP address' via ON_STATS validateIp / decoy). Banned lifted harness.php + old entrypoint.sh left in place (NO rm) but NOT referenced by the new build.

root_cause: SSRF via DNS rebinding / TOCTOU in the GraphQL Asset-upload `_file.url` fetch (CWE-367 / CWE-918)

v0.ref: src/gql/resolvers/mutations/Asset.php handleUpload(): `$this->createGuzzleClient()->request('GET', $url, ['sink' => $tempPath])` fetches `_file.url` with NO host validation (CVE-2025-68437)

v1.ref: CVE-2025-68437 fix = validateHostname($url): parse host, hex-normalize octets, require FILTER_VALIDATE_DOMAIN & reject IP literals, reject a metadata-hostname list, then `gethostbyname($host)` and reject a cloud-metadata IP blocklist (169.254.169.254/170.2, 100.100.100.200, 192.0.0.192). The fetch then RE-RESOLVES the same host via Guzzle/libcurl => separate check-vs-fetch DNS lookups => DNS-rebinding TOCTOU. (fix introduced 5.8.21 commit 013db63, IP blocklist added by 5.8.22)

v2.ref: CVE-2026-27127 fix commit a4cf3fb63bba3249cf1e2882b18a2d29e77a8575: validateHostname() no longer does the gethostbyname/IP-blocklist (-> return true); handleUpload() adds RequestOptions::ON_STATS => validateIp($stats->getHandlerStat('primary_ip')) which validates the ACTUAL connected IP (pins the check to the IP libcurl really dialed).

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: The SSRF validation in Craft CMS's GraphQL Asset mutation performs DNS resolution separately from the HTTP request. This Time-of-Check-Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) vulnerability enables DNS rebinding attacks, where an attacker's DNS server returns different IP addresses for validation compared to the actual request. This is a bypass of the security fix for CVE-2025-68437 (GHSA-x27p-wfqw-hfcc) that allows access to all blocked IPs, not just IPv6 endpoints.
